question: {"question": "What is the design ID word value for UEP1?", "proposed_default": "0x55455031 (ASCII UEP1) in DESIGN_ID, while internal register 0 keeps 0x55445031 as stated."}

{"question": "How are the repeated-number and out-of-order-number counters told apart?", "proposed_default": "A number equal to the last accepted counts as repeated, any other refused number counts as out-of-order."}
{"question": "Is a tick register write while ticks are pending added to or replacing the pending count?", "proposed_default": "Added to the pending count, saturating at 65535."}
{"question": "What does TIMEOUT_CYCLES do?", "proposed_default": "A packet with no end flag within TIMEOUT_CYCLES clocks of the last byte is discarded as too short."}
